notes.title: Announcing Space Menace 2 | Wishlist now!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=tl1KC2JHnnY;full][/previewyoutube]

Hi there everyone,
I'm thrilled to announce my upcoming sci-fi space RTS and battle game, Space Menace 2, now available to wishlist! A heartfelt thank you to all the players of the original Space Menace—your invaluable feedback made this sequel possible.

Space Menace 2 thrusts you into a galaxy on the brink of chaos, where every decision you make shapes the future of the stars. As a space captain, you’ll start with a small, modest fleet, but your journey is anything but ordinary. With the freedom to chart your own course, you'll engage in freelance missions, trade, and battles, earning the credits needed to expand and upgrade your fleet.

[h3]Rise to Power[/h3]
As you rise through the ranks, the stakes grow higher. Initially commanding just a few ships, you'll soon find yourself in control of powerful fleets, gaining the trust and respect of the galaxy's most formidable factions. Align yourself wisely, for your reputation will grant you unprecedented power, from commanding faction fleets to eventually leading entire factions as their supreme leader.

[h3]Customize[/h3]
Customization is key in Space Menace 2. Tailor your fleet with deep loadouts, selecting from a wide array of weapons, utilities, and strike craft to create the perfect combination for your strategic needs. And with mod support, the game allows you to personalize your experience even further, adding new layers of content and possibilities.

[h3]Maximum Excitement, Minimal Grind[/h3]
Space Menace 2 is designed for maximum excitement with minimal grind, offering a deep, strategic experience that evolves as you do. As the game unfolds, so do the challenges and complexities, ensuring every moment is filled with tactical decisions and thrilling encounters. Whether you're outmaneuvering enemy fleets or negotiating with powerful allies, your choices will echo through the galaxy, leaving a legacy that only you can forge.

Wishlist Space Menace 2 now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3136380/Space_Menace_2/

notes.title: Adding Cloud Save and bugs that can appear
notes.content:
Hello there,
I wanted to add the cloud save function to the game for a long time, but since the current save system cannot be saved in the cloud, I haven't been able to add it yet. To add cloud save functionality, I first need to modify the current save system. And changing the save system can create major save problems and that's why I've given up on a new save system many times before. But now I'm working on it again. While I'm doing my best, no problems should arise with the new save system, but if there is a problem, [b]do not start a new game, I repeat do not start a new game[/b]. Just let me know the problem and I will try to solve it as soon as possible.

Hopefully the new save system will be implemented in the next update and cloud save in the update after that if all goes well. Nothing to do on your side, your saves will be automatically converted to the new save system.

Thanks

notes.title: Space Menace full release is here
notes.content:
The full version of Space Menace is here. I wanted to launch the full version with a discount, but due to an error the discount didn't apply.

Although the full version is here, it doesn't mean that I'm done with the game. The game will get the update regularly as long as the players keep sharing their feedbacks/suggestions/ideas.

Whether you have already tried the game or are about to download it, do not hesitate to share your experience. I'm always here to read everyone's response 👍

Thanks a lot

notes.title: Major Content Update
notes.content:
Hello there,
On November 7, I released a big game update that added new contents to the game. To see these new contents, you must completely defeat any faction in the game (except pirates). As always, all feedbacks/suggestions/ideas are most welcome. Feel free to report any bugs you encounter.

Thank you very much 👍

notes.title: The game's full release date is extended
notes.content:
The Space Menace game was set to release on November 4, but I haven't been able to put the finishing touches on the game yet. For this reason, I'm extending the release date for one more week. So now the game will be available on November 11. The game is already available in early access and a big update will hopefully be available in a few days before the full release. Sorry for the wait, I hope players understand that this is for everyone's benefit.
Thanks a lot

notes.title: Help improving Space Menace
notes.content:
Hello there,
I'm a solo game developer, working on Space Menace for over a year now. I have already fixed most of the major bugs and implemented all the features on my list recently and now I have nothing more to do on this game. But it still feels like something is missing and incomplete. Things like the lack of main objectives are one of my biggest concerns. If you want to improve Space Menace, now is the time. You can see Space Menace's latest progress by trying out the demo. Share your feedback, ideas and suggestions to make Space Menace a game you've always wanted to play.

Thank you very much 👍
